rejected.title: DrawText passes 0.0f spacing
rejected.reason: raylib rtext.c: DrawText passes spacing = fontSize/10 (1 at 14px, 2 at 22px, 3 at 30px) — the 0.0f mechanism claim contradicts the raylib source. The comment-inaccuracy core was re-grounded with corrected evidence as note N3.

findings.title: Font loads via CWD-relative runtime read with silent GetFontDefault fallback
findings.evidence: FONT_ASSET :: "assets/fonts/open_sans_regular.ttf" / f := rl.LoadFontEx(FONT_ASSET, FONT_BASE_SIZE, nil, 0) / if rl.IsFontValid(f) {...} / return rl.GetFontDefault()
findings.detail: Blast radius narrowed in verification: wrong-cwd launches exit loudly at data/*.json catalog reads first, so the silent path needs data/ present + assets/fonts missing (partial checkout). In that state the app silently re-renders the illegible default font (the reported defect resurfaces) and a harness re-bless would poison goldens with the wrong font, no diagnostic. Repo precedent exists: palette/assist JSONs are #load-embedded; LoadFontFromMemory over an embedded blob eliminates the cwd dependence entirely.
findings.recommended_fix: Embed the TTF via #load and load with rl.LoadFontFromMemory (keeps app+harness identical), or make the harness fail loud on font-load miss.

findings.title: Assist route-tie caption renders at 11px — missed by the size audit
findings.evidence: caption := "equal cost - split by hash" / fs := i32(max(11, s * 0.30))
findings.verification: confirmed (scale math reproduced: 24.0px tile at 1280x720 -> 0.30*24=7 -> 11px floor)
findings.detail: Player-facing reading text below the PR's own 'nothing below ~14px at 1280x720' canon (job briefing Part 1.2). assist.odin was not in the audit's file set.
findings.recommended_fix: Raise the floor to 14 (fs := i32(max(14, s*0.30))) or rescale the caption; re-bless affected T2s if any capture carries the tie caption.

findings.title: Bottom-right mode label + nudge overlap the tray chips for window widths < ~1256 (incl. the min clamp)
findings.evidence: draw_text(app, mode_label, app.view.win_w - 320, app.view.win_h - 24, 14, p.ink_soft) / total_w := f32(n*TRAY_CHIP_W + (n-1)*TRAY_GAP) (6 chips -> 616px, centered)
findings.verification: confirmed (geometry: label x = win_w-320 = 832 vs tray right edge 884 at 1152; pixel transcription of the committed min-clamp capture reads 'highassist: fu(l) (T cycles)' — text overprints the last chip)
findings.detail: New overlap zone [1152,1256) introduced by this PR (label now tracks win_w; the fixed-1280 pre-PR window never overlapped). The transient nudge (win_h-44) collides with the chip top rows in the same range. 'Seam-verified at min clamp' did not cover this surface.
findings.recommended_fix: Right-anchor the label to clear the tray: x = max(win_w-320, tray_right + 12), or drop the label below the tray band, or clamp chip-row width.

findings.title: Run hint still runs ~38px under the health card for widths < ~1230 (incl. the min clamp)
findings.evidence: draw_text(app, "draw pipes; P / Space pauses; U previews upgrade", 12, 36, 14, p.ink_soft) — measured 372.8px wide (exact TTF metrics) -> ends x=385; card left edge = win_w/2-230 = 347 at 1152; card draws after the hint (main.odin:1181)
findings.verification: confirmed (pixels: hint glyphs terminate at x=346 flush against the card edge at 347 in the committed min-clamp capture — the tail is hidden under the card)
findings.detail: The spec's Design Notes claim the hints 'clear the card's left edge at min width too' — false below ~1230px. Same defect class the PR set out to fix (text half-hidden under the card). Clears 25px at the 1280 default, so the launch-time AC still holds.
findings.recommended_fix: Shorten the hint further, right-truncate at the card edge, or gate the long variant on win_w >= ~1240.

findings.title: Pause-chip two-line threshold (104px) below the hint's real rendered width (121px + 8px inset)
findings.evidence: if avail >= 104 { draw_text(&app, "P/Space to resume", ...12px...) } / chip_w := f32(clamp(i32(avail), 64, 120))
findings.verification: confirmed (fontTools exact advance: 'P/Space to resume' at 12px + spacing 1 = 121.0px; needs 129px incl. inset; chip_w caps at 120)
findings.detail: For win_w in [1208,1238) the hint overhangs the chip and can touch the weather-report card's left margin; at wider sizes the hint always overhangs the chip rect by ~9px (cosmetic, lands in empty gap). The comment's '~98px' measurement is wrong.
findings.recommended_fix: Raise the threshold to 130, or shorten the hint ('P/Space resumes' ~ 82px), or widen the chip clamp.

findings.title: Font-load fallback branch (GetFontDefault) has zero coverage
findings.evidence: the spec's I/O matrix declares the fallback path ('Font file missing at load -> fall back to GetFontDefault') but no test exercises it
findings.detail: The declared error path is never exercised; a regression in the fallback would ship silently.
findings.recommended_fix: A unit check that load_hud_font on a bogus path returns GetFontDefault, plus a loud-fail policy decision for the harness.

findings.recommended_fix: Extract the anchor/gap math into pure helpers and pin them with odin tests (chip threshold, label-vs-tray clearance at 1152/1256).

findings.title: Frozen spec says SetWindowMinSize runs before InitWindow; the code (correctly) calls it after
findings.evidence: spec: 'SetConfigFlags({.WINDOW_RESIZABLE}) + SetWindowMinSize before init (prototype pattern)' / code: rl.InitWindow(...); rl.SetWindowMinSize(MIN_WIN_W, MIN_WIN_H)
findings.verification: confirmed (code is the valid raylib usage; the spec text is inaccurate)
findings.detail: Doc-only inaccuracy in the frozen spec.
findings.recommended_fix: Amend the spec line (SetWindowMinSize after init).

findings.title: 'spacing 1 — the same spacing raylib's DrawText used' is inaccurate for >=20px text
findings.evidence: raylib rtext.c: int spacing = fontSize/defaultFontSize; DrawTextEx(GetFontDefault(), text, position, fontSize, (float)spacing, color) — 2px/char at 22px, 3px/char at 30px under DrawText
findings.verification: confirmed with corrected mechanism (blind's 0.0f claim rejected; raylib uses fontSize/10)
findings.detail: The 22px title and 30px game-over toasts previously rendered with 2-3px inter-char spacing; now 1px — they render ~21-58px narrower. Goldens absorbed the change; only the comment misleads.
findings.recommended_fix: Fix the comment (old spacing was fontSize/10).

findings.title: Sub-min-size windows are unguarded in code — the WM-enforced clamp is the only guard
findings.evidence: chip_w := f32(clamp(i32(avail), 64, 120)) — below win_w 1128 the chip overlaps the forecast card; below 980 the top band collapses; relies entirely on SetWindowMinSize being honored
findings.verification: confirmed (arithmetic checks out; macOS honors min-size hints, so reachable only via exotic paths — fullscreen-to-smaller-display, programmatic resize)
findings.detail: Defense-in-depth gap only; the clamp makes it unreachable in practice.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: clamp gap_l/gap_r or skip chip drawing when avail < 0.

reviewer_agreement.note: font cwd-relative + silent fallback — highest-confidence finding

verdict_rationale: 0 blockers: both user-reported defects fixed and verified (readable bundled font, resizable window, presentation-only invariants all hold — T1 byte-identical, harness 28/28 twice, lint green, golden fold 1:1 with the listed inventory). 8 warnings: two new min-clamp overlap zones on secondary HUD surfaces (W3/W4), one size-canon miss (W2), the pause-chip threshold (W5), the cwd-dependent font load (W1 — recommend the embed), and coverage gaps. None violate the spec's named ACs; all are fixable in a follow-up push (I re-review automatically).
